correctness.rationale: The four-field linearization at (1,1,h,h), projected onto Neumann eigenvalue κ, has characteristic quartic (z+t)^4+(5/2)(z+t)^2−(11/2)g(z+t)+g² with t=1+κ, g=hκ. Independent SymPy calculation verified the 4×4 determinant, Δ2=20t³+5t+(11/2)g>0 and Δ3=4t²(5/2+4t²)²−((11/2)^2+16t²)g². For first nonzero disk eigenvalue κ=1, a4=h²−11h+26 and Δ3=5476−377h²/4 give the three exact boundaries h± and hosc. Higher disk modes κ>5/4 have a4=(g−11t/4)^2+t²(t²−81/16)>0; the positive derivative polynomial makes their oscillatory thresholds larger than first-mode hosc. Constant mode remains stable, high modes decay. Thus the two strict stability intervals and the two stationary plus one oscillatory crossings follow with duplicated disk angular eigenvalues; at critical parameters no exponential stability is asserted.
